criteria.name: 1 marketing: a check-in is sent only when consents.marketing is true
criteria.label: outcome

criteria.name: 2 opt-out: after optOut the next decision is refused, others are not, and it survives a new process
criteria.label: outcome

criteria.name: 3 zone: a missing or UTC timezone uses deviceTimezone, and no usable zone means not sent
criteria.label: outcome

criteria.name: 4 cap: one check-in per user per local day, counted on the local day, exactly one under 2 processes x 12 calls
criteria.why: FAIL repeat 1: 19 sends across 2 processes x 12 calls, want 1; repeat 2: 19 sends across 2 processes x 12 calls, want 1; repeat 3: 19 sends across 2 processes x 12 calls, want 1
criteria.label: outcome

criteria.name: 5 dismissals: three dismissals of checkin stop the check-in, not a tip, and a user without dismissals still gets it
criteria.label: outcome

criteria.name: 6 kill switch: proactiveEnabled false stops sending at once, true resumes in the same process
criteria.label: outcome
